                  if (width >= 1024) return 'desktop';
                  if (width >= 768) return 'tablet';

hackathon</strong> designed to bring together developers and filmmakers to reimagine the future of cinema using artificial intelligence.</p>
<p>Hosted in <strong>Hyderabad</strong>, this two-day hackathon challenges participants to explore how AI can transform storytelling, production, editing, and film marketing. From automating post-production workflows to building intelligent storytelling tools, Cine AI Hackfest is where technology meets creativity.</p>
<p>Whether you’re a coder experimenting with generative AI, a filmmaker curious about automation, or a creator looking to build something bold — this hackathon is your playground.</p>
<p>Participants will collaborate in teams, build real working prototypes, and present their solutions to an expert panel. The best ideas stand a chance to win exciting cash prizes and gain recognition in the growing AI-film ecosystem.</p>
<p>🚀 <strong>Build. Create. Disrupt Cinema with AI.</strong></p>
<h3>ABOUT LORVEN AI</h3>
<p>Lorven AI Studio is India's first AI-driven filmmaking platform, launched by acclaimed producer Dil Raju, known for films like Vakeel saab, Fida, Balagam and many more</p>
<p>Built for filmmakers, writers, and producers, Lorven AI optimizes both creative and production workflows—without compromising artistic intent.</p>
<p>The platform brings together four powerful modules:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Cine Scribe</strong> — From idea to production-ready scripts</li>
<li><strong>Cine Sketch</strong> — Instant cinematic storyboards</li>
<li><strong>Pitch Craft</strong> — Investor- and studio-ready pitch decks, auto-generated</li>
<li><strong>Cine Flow</strong> — End-to-end planning with scheduling, locations, and call sheets.</li>
</ul>
<p>Lorven AI empowers creators to move faster, plan smarter, and deliver films with sharper control over timelines and budgets.</p></div></div></div><div class="bg-white rounded-xl overflow-hidden <p>Portkey is building the <strong>control plane for production AI applications</strong> — the infrastructure layer that powers, observes, and manages how AI systems run in the real world.</p>
<p>From routing LLM requests and handling fallbacks to monitoring performance, reliability, and cost, Portkey helps fast-growing teams ship AI features with confidence.</p>
<p>We work with teams running <strong>mission-critical AI workloads</strong>, where uptime, observability, and performance matter. If you’re excited about AI infrastructure, developer experience, and building tools that power real-world AI products, you’ll feel at home here.</p>
<h2><strong>Challenge Overview</strong></h2>
<p>This is not a typical hackathon challenge. It’s a hands-on simulation of what it actually feels like to work on <strong>production-grade AI systems</strong>.</p>
<p>You’ll tackle problems that mirror real scenarios engineers face while shipping and maintaining AI infrastructure at scale. The focus is on how you think, how you debug, and how you reason about systems when things aren’t perfect.</p>
<p>Expect challenges around understanding system behavior, tracing failures, making smart trade-offs, and communicating decisions clearly. This is about clarity over flash, depth over demos, and ownership over shortcuts.</p>
<p>Strong performers won’t just walk away with prizes. They’ll stand out to the <strong>Portkey</strong> team as engineers who can operate close to real-world production systems.</p>
<h2><strong>Who Should Participate</strong></h2>
<p>This challenge is ideal for:</p>
<ul>
<li>Engineers who enjoy solving real-world problems</li>
<li>Developers curious about how AI systems work in production</li>
<li>Builders who enjoy debugging and system-level thinking</li>
<li>People who value clean design, reasoning, and clarity</li>
</ul>
<p>You do <strong>not</strong> need prior experience with Portkey to participate.</p>
<h2><strong>Beyond the Build</strong></h2>
<p>Great work deserves to be seen. Standout participants will be rewarded with exciting prizes and get the opportunity to be recognised by the Portkey team, with exceptional performers potentially turning this challenge into a full-time role.</p>
<h2><strong>Why Participate</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Work on <strong>real AI infrastructure problems</strong></li>
<li>Learn how production systems behave at scale</li>
<li>Get evaluated on <strong>thinking, not trivia</strong></li>
<li>Build something meaningful, not just a demo</li>
<li>Interact with engineers solving real-world AI problems</li>
</ul>
<p>If you enjoy building, debugging, and learning fast — this challenge is built for you.</p></div></div></div><div class="bg-white rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm border"><div class="px-3 py-4 md:text-base"><p>At its core, <strong>Hackaccino</strong> is the <strong>heart of the tech culture</strong> here at <strong>Bennett University</strong>. Organized by the <strong>Computer Society of India (CSI)</strong>, it’s our <strong>annual 24-hour sprint</strong> where <em>ideas actually come to life</em>. We don’t just want to see another slide deck; we want to see <strong>code that works</strong> and <strong>prototypes that solve real problems</strong>. As <strong>Bennett’s biggest hackathon</strong>, this is the one weekend a year where we <strong>trade sleep for logic</strong> and turn the campus into a <strong>massive innovation hub</strong>.</p>
<h3>🚀 The Legacy of Innovation</h3>
<p>Last year was a <strong>milestone</strong> for us—seeing <strong>over 3,600 hackers</strong> come together was a massive vibe. It wasn’t just about the competition; it was about the <strong>energy of staying up all night</strong>, <strong>debugging with teammates</strong>, and getting <strong>mid-hack advice from mentors</strong> at companies like <strong>PW, Rabbitt AI, and HackQuest</strong>. We saw some <strong>insane projects</strong> win the <strong>Cloud and AI tracks</strong>, and our <strong>All-Girls Team winners</strong> proved exactly why <strong>inclusivity in tech isn't just a buzzword—it's a necessity</strong>.</p>
<h3>🔥 Why Join the Madness?</h3>
<p><strong>Hackaccino 4.0</strong> is an <strong>Open Solution playground</strong>.</p>
<p><strong>Build, Network, and Scale.</strong> Whether you’re a first-year student just starting with <strong>Python</strong> or a senior who’s basically a <strong>full-stack pro</strong>, there’s a place for you here. It’s about the <strong>3 AM caffeine runs</strong>, the <strong>networking with industry leaders</strong>, and the <strong>sheer rush of demoing a working prototype</strong>. This isn't just another college event; it’s where we <strong>prove what our generation can build</strong>.</p></div></div></div><div class="bg-white rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm border"><div <p><strong>NXTGEN</strong> is a 24-hour <strong>Software Innovation Hackathon</strong> hosted at <strong>Express Avenue Mall</strong> as part of <strong>TEXUS 2026</strong>, the flagship fest of <strong>SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Ramapuram</strong>. It brings together student developers and software innovators to think fast, collaborate intensively, and build impactful digital solutions beyond classroom boundaries.</p>
<p>Set in a dynamic public venue, teams ideate, design, and develop <strong>software-based solutions</strong> across diverse tracks through rapid experimentation, coding, and teamwork. More than just a competition, <strong>NXTGEN</strong> is a celebration of technology, creativity, and next-generation software-driven ideas.</p>

<h2>Important Note</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>NXTGEN is strictly a software-only hackathon.</strong><br>

</li>
<li>
<p>This is an <strong>open innovation hackathon</strong> where teams define their own <strong>software problem statements</strong> for <strong>Round 1 shortlisting</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Problem Statements (PS) for Round 2</strong> will be provided <strong>on the spot</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>All ideas must align with <strong>one of the official software tracks</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Plagiarism or copied software projects</strong> will result in <strong>immediate disqualification</strong>.</p>
</li>
</ul>

<p>Hosted in <strong>Hyderabad</strong>, this two-day hackathon challenges participants to explore how AI can transform storytelling, production, editing, and film marketing. <p>Whether you’re a coder experimenting with generative AI, a filmmaker curious about automation, or a creator looking to build something bold — this hackathon is your playground.</p>
<p>Participants will collaborate in teams, build real working prototypes, and present their solutions to an expert panel. The best ideas stand a chance to win exciting cash prizes and gain recognition in the growing AI-film ecosystem.</p>
<p>🚀 <strong>Build. Create. Disrupt Cinema with AI.</strong></p>
<h3>ABOUT LORVEN AI</h3>
<p>Lorven AI Studio is India's first AI-driven filmmaking platform, launched by acclaimed producer Dil Raju, known for films like Vakeel saab, Fida, Balagam and many more</p>
<p>Built for filmmakers, writers, and producers, Lorven AI optimizes both creative and production workflows—without compromising artistic intent.</p>
<p>The platform brings together four powerful modules:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Cine Scribe</strong> — From idea to production-ready scripts</li>
<li><strong>Cine Sketch</strong> — Instant cinematic storyboards</li>
<li><strong>Pitch Craft</strong> — Investor- and studio-ready pitch decks, auto-generated</li>
<li><strong>Cine Flow</strong> — End-to-end planning with scheduling, locations, and call sheets.</li>
</ul>
<p>Lorven AI empowers creators to move faster, plan smarter, and deliver films with sharper control over timelines and budgets.</p></div></div></div><div class="bg-white rounded-xl overflow-hidden
